summary: Alibaba Group filed a Form 6-K with an attached Hong Kong exchange announcement regarding an administrative adjustment to the exchange rate of its zero-coupon exchangeable bonds due 2032. The adjustment, effective August 14, 2026, lowered the exchange price from HK$6.23 to HK$5.92 per Alibaba Health share and increased the exchange ratio from 160,513.6 to 168,918.9 AH Shares per HK$1,000,000 principal, following a dividend declaration by Alibaba Health. The number of AH Shares exchangeable rose from 1,928,855,537 to 2,030,912,162. This is a routine bond terms adjustment, not a special situation.
